deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: The Biology department page says 5 pm EST; MIT's graduate admissions page says 11:59 pm Eastern. Submit by 5 pm to be safe.

timeline.interviews: Invitations go out by email in mid-January. In-person interviews, required for an offer, take place in February. Travel is covered, with cost-sharing for international students.
timeline.decisions: Decisions are sent after the interviews.

english.note: Required if English is not your first language and your college studies were not in English. The Biology department page lists IELTS 6.5 and says IELTS is preferred; MIT's graduate admissions page lists 7. Scores must be from the past two years.

applicationFee.note: The fee cannot be waived for international applicants.

requirements.note: At least two letters must be academic.

funding.note: MIT's graduate admissions page says all doctoral students receive full tuition and a living stipend.
